page_title: CRY 0-2 BOU | Crystal Palace v Bournemouth 06/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
90+4' Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
90+1' 0 - 2 Goal! Philip Billing picks out Kieffer Moore (Bournemouth) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the bottom right corner with a header from close range. 0:2.
90+1' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A rebound sits up perfectly for Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post.
89' A dangerous looking corner kick from Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is cleared to safety by the defence.
88' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kieffer Moore (Bournemouth) replacing Dominic Solanke.
86' That's the end of the game for Jefferson Lerma, who is replaced by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace).

84' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
83' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
83' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
80' The free kick is delivered by Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
80' The referee blows his whistle as Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in his challenge. There is a free kick near the sideline to Crystal Palace.
79' We are about to witness a substitution. Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is replacing Luis Sinisterra.
76' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
75' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) was too forceful with his tackle and Craig Pawson interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
73' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
69' Here is a change. Joel Ward is going off and Roy Hodgson gives the last tactical orders to Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
69' The substitution has been made. Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) has replaced Jeffrey Schlupp.
67' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
67' The ball is out of play and Crystal Palace manage to earn a corner.
65' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes it short.
65' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Bournemouth will take a corner kick.
63' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) finds some space inside the box and produces a first-time shot that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
63' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) for his blatant foul.
62' Antoine Semenyo goes off the pitch and Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) comes on.
62' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Justin Kluivert will be replaced by Philip Billing (Bournemouth).
56' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
54' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
53' The foul by Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Craig Pawson.
49' POST! Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
48' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace).
47' Crystal Palace couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Neto (Bournemouth) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Craig Pawson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) gets inside the box and tries to beat Sam Johnstone with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
45+2' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) commits a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) is given a yellow card.
44' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

43' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Craig Pawson with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Bournemouth in a dangerous position.
42' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
39' The current number of shots on goal is 3:2.
37' Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Neto intercepts the ball.
35' A brilliant individual effort! Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post.
33' Marcos Senesi floats in a cross for Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and floats high over the bar.
33' Bournemouth failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
29' Tyrick Mitchell is substituted due to injury. Roy Hodgson gives a chance to Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace).
27' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
27' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Neto thwarts him with a great two-handed save.

26' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The ball goes out of play. Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.
25' 0 - 1 GOAL! The corner comes over and Luis Sinisterra wins a simple header before Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) nods the ball into the back of the net. 0:1.
25' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) will take the corner.
23' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
23' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Bournemouth earn a corner.

22' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
22' Craig Pawson blows the whistle, Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) is penalised for a foul. Crystal Palace are awarded a free kick.
20' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
19' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
17' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
16' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
14' Dangerous play by Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace). Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
10' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
9' The corner is swung in but Crystal Palace can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

9' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom right corner, but Sam Johnstone pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
8' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sam Johnstone, who smothers the ball.
6' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

5' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the top left corner, but Neto thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The referee blows his whistle, Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.
3' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) wasted a big chance to finish after the resulting free kick! He latched on to a well-placed cross deep inside the box and produced a fine header towards the net!
2' Craig Pawson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Adam Smith (Bournemouth) and blew his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Crystal Palace.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Bournemouth will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Craig Pawson.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
